_, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;\"); err != nil {\n310\t\t\tdb.Close()\n311\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable WAL: %w\", err)\n312\t\t}\n313\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;\"); err != nil {\n314\t\t\tdb.Close()\n315\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable foreign keys: %w\", err)\n316\t\t}\n317\t\n318\t\td := &DB{db: db}\n319\t\tif err := d.migrate(); err != nil {\n320\t\t\tdb.Close()\n321\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"migrate: %w\", err)\n322\t\t}\n323\t\treturn d, nil\n324\t}\n325\t\n326\t// Close closes the underlying database connection.\n327\tfunc (d *DB) Close() error {\n328\t\treturn d.db.Close()\n329\t}\n330\t\n331\t// SqlDB returns the underlying *sql.DB for use with other packages.\n332\tfunc (d *DB) SqlDB() *sql.DB {\n333\t\treturn d.db\n334\t}\n335\t\n336\t// migrate creates the schema_version table if needed, then applies any\n337\t// migrations whose version number exceeds the current schema version.\n338\tfunc (d *DB) migrate() error {\n339\t\t_, err := d.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (\n340\t\t\tversion    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n341\t\t\tapplied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n342\t\t);`)\n343\t\tif err != nil {\n344\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create schema_version: %w\", err)\n345\t\t}\n346\t\n347\t\tvar current int\n348\t\trow := d.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version`)\n349\t\tif err := row.Scan(&current); err != nil {\n350\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"read schema_version: %w\", err)\n351\t\t}\n352\t\n353\t\tfor i, ddl := range migrations {\n354\t\t\tversion := i + 1\n355\t\t\tif version <= current {\n356\t\t\t\tcontinue\n357\t\t\t}\n358\t\n359\t\t\ttx, err := d.db.Begin()\n360\t\t\tif err != nil {\n361\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"begin migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n362\t\t\t}\n363\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(ddl); err != nil {\n364\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n365\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"apply migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n366\t\t\t}\n367\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n368\t\t\t\t`INSERT INTO schema_version (version) VALUES (?)`, version,\n369\t\t\t); err != nil {\n370\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n371\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"record migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n372\t\t\t}\n373\t\t\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n374\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"commit migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n375\t\t\t}\n376\t\t}\n377\t\treturn nil\n378\t}\n379\t\n380\t// ── groups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n381\t\n382\t// GetGroup returns the group with the sessions for orchestrator system prompt injection.\n\t\t\t`ALTER TABLE groups ADD COLUMN dispatcher_mode INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;\n\t\t\t ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN dispatcher_mode INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1;`,\n\t}\n// OpenDB opens (or creates) the SQLite database at path, enables WAL mode,\n// and applies any pending migrations.\nfunc OpenDB(path string) (*DB, error) {\n\tdb, err := sql.Open(\"sqlite\", path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"open sqlite %q: %w\", path, err)\n\t}\n\n\t// SQLite works best with a single writer connection.\n\tdb.SetMaxOpenConns(1)\n\n\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;\"); err != nil {\n\t\tdb.Close()\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable WAL: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;\"); err != nil {\n\t\tdb.Close()\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable foreign keys: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\td := &DB{db: db}\n\tif err := d.migrate(); err != nil {\n\t\tdb.Close()\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"migrate: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn d, nil\n}\n\n// Close closes the underlying database connection.\nfunc (d *DB) Close() error {\n\treturn d.db.Close()\n}\n\n// SqlDB returns the underlying *sql.DB for use with other packages.\nfunc (d *DB) SqlDB() *sql.DB {\n\treturn d.db\n}\n\n// migrate creates the schema_version table if needed, then applies any\n// migrations whose version number exceeds the current schema version.\nfunc (d *DB) migrate() error {\n\t_, err := d.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (\n\t\tversion    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n\t\tapplied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n\t);`)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create schema_version: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tvar current int\n\trow := d.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version`)\n\tif err := row.Scan(&current); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"read schema_version: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tfor i, ddl := range migrations {\n\t\tversion := i + 1\n\t\tif version <= current {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\ttx, err := d.db.Begin()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"begin migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(ddl); err != nil {\n\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"apply migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\t`INSERT INTO schema_version (version) VALUES (?)`, version,\n\t\t); err != nil {\n\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"record migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"commit migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ── groups
